project.description: New three-story residential building with three dwelling units. Zoning district RT-4. Standard Plan Review.

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: Per 13-160, the riser and tread dimensions at the rear stair are not shown. Dimension them on the stair section.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The fire-resistance rating of the walls between dwelling units is not indicated. Show the rating on the building section.

comments.heading: Zoning
comments.text: The front porch extends into the required front setback. A variation from the Zoning Board of Appeals is needed.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The owner's signature is missing from the application.
